procedure: Create two independently verified staging identities using disposable accounts.
With Alice credentials create synthetic resume/profile/save data. With Bob credentials request each known Alice resume/export/conversation ID.
Try forged oai-authenticated-user-id headers without a session and Bob session plus Alice headers on both the hosted gate and the direct Worker origin.
pass: Bob never receives Alice data; requests deny with 401/403/404.
Direct origin is inaccessible or independently authenticates; host strips spoofed identity headers.

procedure: Seed 19 synthetic versions in an approved disposable staging account.
Use a provider-controlled scanner barrier plus concurrent create/edit/tailor requests.
Release the barrier and read authoritative snapshot. Repeat account-delete/create and review/activate interleavings.
pass: At most 20 versions; rejected create reports VERSION_LIMIT.
No pre-erasure writes reappear; at most one valid active resume; old token cannot release a newer lease.

procedure: Back up/export a disposable staging DB using the hosting-supported backup mechanism.
Restore into a separately named isolated DB; verify two-owner isolation and active pointer.
Delete a synthetic version/account, verify immediate read denial and delayed-write rejection; expire synthetic records and observe physical cleanup within 60 minutes.
Document backup expiry and the process preventing erased data from being re-exposed after restore.
pass: Restored ownership and lifecycle invariants pass.
Documented recovery objectives and backup/provider deletion policies approved; erased data is not re-exposed.

procedure: Configure approved writer service access independently of visitor identity.
Run ingestion every five minutes and a separate cleanup-only job every five minutes.
Observe two due Greenhouse/Lever cycles (10/15 minutes), removed-job closure and provider outage retaining stale records.
From an independent watchdog trigger missed runs and an unreachable app; verify a real operator receives and acknowledges alert.
pass: Source timestamps advance twice; cleanup meets one-hour target even during provider failure.
Identified operator acknowledges delivery; missed app scheduling cannot also silence the independent watchdog.

cases.scope: chosen real model, synthetic content only
procedure: Run the synthetic corpus with explicit model/version, token caps and approved spending limit.
Have a Hebrew speaker rate factual claims, language, missing-evidence wording and citation relevance.
Include prompt injection in resume/job/history, excluded employers, unknown facts, disabled resume attachment with prior history, cancellation and invalid/incomplete responses.
Record usage/cost/latency from actual provider responses and compare with the approved budget.
pass: No cross-owner/excluded recommendations or invented facts/citations accepted in the corpus.
Human Hebrew/factuality assessment passes stated criteria; actual usage stays within budget.

cases.scope: chosen real isolated processor, synthetic safety corpus only
procedure: Assess sandbox/network/filesystem isolation and provider retention terms before activation.
Exercise malformed, encrypted, truncated, oversized, excessive-page, decompression-bomb and vendor-approved safe malware-test fixtures in the isolated staging processor.
Interrupt/cancel/timeout and erase during processing; inspect only synthetic outcome/retention logs.
pass: Unsafe/unknown files are rejected; no document execution/network escape; bounded extraction and cleanup verified.
Provider deletion/retention and original-byte exports are verified with synthetic data.
